title: Solicit a rationale: invite a comment when someone votes or rates
description:
As the publication, I want to invite a short reason with each vote or rating, so that signals come with explanations.

```gherkin
Feature: Rationale prompt
  Scenario: Prompt after rating
    Given a reader just rated an item
    Then an optional "why?" field is offered
    And skipping it does not undo the rating

  Scenario: Rationale is linked
    When the reader submits a rationale
    Then it is stored as a comment linked to that vote
```
